forbid.message: Inline styles are not allowed. Use makeStyles with Fluent tokens instead. See .github/copilot-instructions.md

no-restricted-syntax.message: Hardcoded hex colors are not allowed for standard UI. Use Fluent design tokens (e.g., tokens.colorNeutralForeground1). Exception: Azure brand blues (#0078D4, #106EBE, #005A9E).
